# New Event in Skyline Valley: Dangerous Pastime (All Rewards)

![New Event in Skyline Valley: Dangerous Pastime (All Rewards)](/uploads/360_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

A lot of news awaits you in the **Skyline Valley Update (June 2024)** with the **map expansion** in southern Appalachia in Shenandoah National Park. One of them is a new public event called "**Dangerous Pastime**". The event takes place at the **Thunder Mountain Substation TM-03** in the northeast of Skyline Valley. There we help some settlers carry out dangerous experiments with the lightning catchers at the substation. 

![Event: Dangerous Pastimes](/uploads/nukaknights-post-dangerous-pastimes-20240526104100-1.jpg) 

## Event flow

First, talk to the settlers who are in the building at the substation via an intercom. They will then explain to you what you have to do in the event.

Then you walk in a circle around the outer area of ​​the substation and collect all the lightning catcher spare parts. You then bring the pieces together to the lightning catcher in the middle. Numerous Lost people will come your way, which can cause significant energy damage in close combat. Many of them also spawn on the street, so it makes sense for someone to place themselves on the wall on the street and stop the lost ones there.

At the end of the event, a giant legendary hermit crab named "Thunder Crab" spawns with 3* as the final boss.

## Rewards

- 1000 XP
- 150 bottle caps
- 1-3 legendary cores
- 3 government bonds
- 1-2 Rad-X or Rad-X diluted
- Contextual ammunition
- 1 stimpak
- 2-3 improved repair kits
